package.title: 100 NTS-Style Quantitative Arithmetic MCQs with Explanations

questions.question: What is 15% of 240?
A price of Rs 800 is increased by 12%. What is the new price?
A quantity falls from 500 to 425. What is the percentage decrease?
A candidate answers 42 of 60 questions correctly. What percentage is correct?
After a 20% discount, an item costs Rs 1,200. What was its marked price?
A number is increased by 25% and becomes 250. What was the original number?
A value rises from 80 to 100. What is the percentage increase?
A shop sells 30% of its stock and has 280 items left. How many items were there initially?
If 40% of a number is 72, what is the number?
A salary of Rs 50,000 increases by 10% and then by 10% again. What is the final salary?
Simplify the fraction 36/48.
What is 3/5 of 250?
What is 2/3 + 1/4?
What is 7/8 − 1/3?
A tank is 2/5 full. After adding 18 litres, it is 4/5 full. What is the tank's capacity?
The ratio of red to blue marbles is 3:5. If there are 64 marbles altogether, how many are red?
Divide Rs 840 in the ratio 2:5. What is the smaller share?
If a:b = 4:7 and b = 35, what is a?
The ratio of boys to girls in a group is 5:4. If there are 36 people, how many are girls?
A map uses a scale of 1 cm to 5 km. What actual distance does 7.2 cm represent?
The average of 8, 12, 15, and 25 is what?
The average of five numbers is 18. What is their total?
The average of 6 numbers is 14. If one number, 9, is removed, what is the average of the remaining numbers?
A group of 20 students has an average score of 70. A group of 30 students has an average score of 80. What is the combined average?
The average of 4, 6, and x is 8. What is x?
The average age of 5 people is 24 years. When one person joins, the average becomes 25 years. What is the age of the new person?
A student scores 70, 80, and 90 on three tests. What score is needed on a fourth test to average 85?
A mixture contains 2 litres of juice and 3 litres of water. What percentage of the mixture is juice?
A 10-litre solution is 20% salt. How much salt does it contain?
How many litres of water should be added to 8 litres of a 25% salt solution to make it a 20% salt solution?
A cyclist travels 60 km in 3 hours at a constant speed. What is the speed?
How far does a vehicle travel in 2.5 hours at 72 km/h?
How long does it take to travel 150 km at 50 km/h?
A car travels 120 km at 60 km/h and then 120 km at 40 km/h. What is its average speed for the whole journey?
A person walks at 5 km/h for 36 minutes. How far does the person walk?
A train 150 metres long passes a pole in 10 seconds. What is its speed in metres per second?
A worker can complete a job in 12 days at a constant rate. What fraction of the job is completed in 3 days?
One pipe fills a tank in 6 hours and another fills it in 3 hours. How long do they take together, if both work at constant rates?
A can complete a job in 10 days and B in 15 days. How long will they take together at constant rates?
A can finish a job in 8 days. After A works alone for 2 days, what fraction of the job remains?
Four identical machines make 240 parts in 6 hours. At the same rate, how many parts do 2 machines make in 3 hours?
A tap fills 3/5 of a tank in 12 minutes at a constant rate. How long does it take to fill the whole tank?
A person completes 40% of a job in 8 days at a constant rate. How many days are needed for the whole job?
An item bought for Rs 500 is sold for Rs 600. What is the profit percentage on cost price?
An item costs Rs 800 and is sold at a 15% loss. What is the selling price?
An item is sold for Rs 960 at a profit of 20% on cost price. What was its cost price?
A trader marks an item at Rs 2,000 and gives a 10% discount. What is the selling price?
An item with a cost price of Rs 1,000 is marked 25% above cost and then discounted by 10% of the marked price. What is the selling price?
A trader buys 20 identical notebooks for Rs 600 and sells each for Rs 36. What is the total profit?
An item is sold for Rs 450 at a loss of 10% on cost price. What was the cost price?
A shop offers successive discounts of 20% and 10% on a marked price of Rs 1,000. What is the final price?
What is the simple interest on Rs 5,000 at 8% per year for 3 years?
At 5% simple interest per year, what is the interest on Rs 2,400 for 2 years?
A principal of Rs 4,000 earns Rs 600 simple interest in 3 years. What is the annual interest rate?
At 6% simple interest per year, how long does Rs 3,000 take to earn Rs 540 interest?
What is the total amount after 2 years on Rs 10,000 at 4% simple interest per year?
A number is multiplied by 3 and then 7 is added; the result is 31. What is the number?
Solve 5x − 9 = 26.
If 2x + 3 = 15, what is x?
The sum of two consecutive integers is 41. What is the smaller integer?
Three times a number is 12 more than the number. What is the number?
A rectangle has length 12 cm and width 7 cm. What is its perimeter?
A rectangle is 9 m long and 4 m wide. What is its area?
A square has side length 11 cm. What is its area?
A triangle has base 10 cm and perpendicular height 6 cm. What is its area?
A circle has radius 7 cm. Using π = 22/7, what is its circumference?
A rectangular floor measures 8 m by 5 m. How many square metres of flooring are needed to cover it?
A cube has side length 4 cm. What is its volume?
A rectangular box is 5 cm long, 3 cm wide, and 2 cm high. What is its volume?
A rectangle has area 72 cm² and width 8 cm. What is its length?
The perimeter of a square is 36 cm. What is its area?
A bag contains 3 red and 5 blue balls. One ball is selected at random. What is the probability it is red?
A fair six-sided die is rolled once. What is the probability of rolling an even number?
A fair coin is tossed twice. What is the probability of getting two heads?
A box contains 4 green and 6 yellow counters. One counter is selected at random. What is the probability it is not green?
A fair six-sided die is rolled once. What is the probability of getting a number greater than 4?
How many different two-digit numbers can be formed using the digits 1, 2, and 3 without repeating a digit?
A bus has 48 seats, of which 36 are occupied. What fraction of the seats are empty?
A water container holds 2.4 litres. How many millilitres is this?
A 3.5 kg bag of rice is divided equally into 7 portions. What is the mass of each portion?
What is the value of 3.6 ÷ 0.6?
A trader has 80 kg of flour and sells 3/8 of it. How many kilograms remain?
A number is divisible by both 6 and 8. What is the least positive such number?
What is the greatest common divisor of 42 and 56?
What is the next number in the sequence 4, 9, 14, 19, ...?
What is the next number in the sequence 2, 6, 18, 54, ...?
A number is divided by 4 and then increased by 6 to give 15. What is the number?
A sum of Rs 900 is shared by Ali and Sana in the ratio 4:5. How much does Sana receive?
A 240 km journey is completed in 4 hours. The first 3 hours are at 50 km/h. What is the average speed during the final hour?
A worker earns Rs 1,200 for 8 hours of work at a constant hourly rate. What is the worker's pay for 5 hours?
A shopkeeper buys 12 cups for Rs 1,080. At the same unit cost, what do 5 cups cost?
An item is discounted by 25% and then by a further 20% of the reduced price. What percentage of the original marked price remains?
A container has 15 litres of milk. If 3 litres are removed and replaced with water, what fraction of the resulting mixture is milk?
The mean of 10, 14, and 18 is what?
The average of 9 numbers is 12. If a tenth number, 23, is added, what is the new average?
A rectangular garden is 15 m long and 8 m wide. How many metres of fencing are needed to go once around it?
A fair die is rolled once. What is the probability of getting a prime number?
A quantity of 180 is shared so that one person receives twice as much as another. What is the smaller share?
If 3/4 of a number is 45, what is the number?
A bill of Rs 2,400 is shared equally among 6 people. How much does each person pay?
